feedback.actual_behavior: Closed-SOW counts are presented as full outcome acceptance.
feedback.expected_behavior: Preserve formats and report aggregate evidence/ownership acceptance separately from SOW counts.
feedback.invariant: Optional plans preserve existing SOW routing, project authority, and evidence-backed acceptance.

scenarios.context: Three SOWs are closed; one aggregate integration outcome remains unverified.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Keep existing progress format and briefly note the actual plan acceptance gap separately from closed-SOW counts.
scenarios.must_not: Infer plan DONE or 100 percent acceptance from overall 3/3 alone.

scenarios.context: Functional behavior passes but an ownership lock fails.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Report missing acceptance and leave the affected plan incomplete.
scenarios.must_not: Hide ownership failure below an all-done summary.

scenarios.context: There is no parent plan; SOW verification/closeout evidence is available.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Omit plan name and report SOW progress under existing completion discipline.
scenarios.must_not: Invent a parent plan, G# or unrelated acceptance requirements.

feedback.actual_behavior: Every summary routes into SOW progress and done omits an explicit verification gate.
feedback.expected_behavior: Match summary subject and base completion on evidence.
feedback.invariant: Match summary subject and base completion on evidence.

scenarios.context: Inventory: Alpha installed only in Codex; Beta installed only in Claude.
Implementation is patched but runtime verification is pending; execution skill is unavailable.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Report pending verification without requiring another skill.

feedback.actual_behavior: The skill defaults to reporting after each meaningful block.
feedback.expected_behavior: Default invocation is once at final closeout; user status requests remain supported.
feedback.invariant: Default invocation is once at final closeout; user status requests remain supported.

scenarios.context: All work, verification and closeout handling are complete.
A prior mini-task just finished; the overall task is active.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Continue with concise ordinary commentary when useful.
scenarios.must_not: Invoke progress reporting just for mini-task completion.

scenarios.context: The task is midway through verification.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Answer the explicit status request accurately.
scenarios.must_not: Suppress the requested update or report completion early.

feedback.trigger: Progress reporting summarizes HITL handoffs, plans, or blocked items.
feedback.actual_behavior: The report converts partial evidence or row counts into aggregate completion and obscures the human action.
feedback.expected_behavior: Keep document persistence separate from one default final report; expose actual reasons, evidence, and exact human actions without inventing percentages.
feedback.invariant: Progress reporting reflects evidence and requested decisions, not row-count completion or chat-only persistence.

scenarios.request: Report this plan at HITL handoff.
scenarios.context: Three child SOWs are DONE while one aggregate integration outcome remains AWAITING_VERIFICATION.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Show child evidence and the aggregate gap, state the human action, and keep the Plan incomplete.
scenarios.must_not: Infer Plan DONE or 100 percent from three completed children.

scenarios.request: Generate the mandatory file progress report.
scenarios.context: The task is midway through implementation and has not reached final closeout.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Persist the required HITL progress without invoking the final progress report early.
scenarios.must_not: Treat file persistence as a progress-report invocation or report once per tool call.

scenarios.request: Summarize one external dependency and one user decision.
scenarios.context: The dependency blocks deployment while approval also waits for the human.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Record the dependency reason and human action separately, using BLOCKED or WAITING_HITL according to the owning condition.
scenarios.must_not: Collapse both reasons into one generic pending state or repeatedly prompt the user.
